description: 3 exemplars + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Authored 2026-10-09 when the settings-key retirement touched this skill. Exemplars shape a fuzzy ask into a backlog item, including the German form. Near-misses are sizing a ticket and planning a feature's architecture, both downstream of a refined item.

queries.q: help me write this ticket — customers say the dashboard is slow
turn this vague request into a user story with clear acceptance criteria
mach aus dieser groben Anfrage ein sauberes Backlog-Item mit Problem und Akzeptanzkriterien
how many story points is this ticket?
plan the architecture and phases for the new billing feature
queries.note: planning a feature end to end rather than framing one backlog item → feature-planning
